name: 1-start.jpg
caption: Golden hour on the Palm Strip: the Solaris GT on the palm-lined coastal boulevard past lit Art Deco hotels, with the pier wheel over the turquoise bay and the full live HUD.

name: 2-chase.jpg
caption: Four-star twilight pursuit: cruisers boxing in the supercar, red and blue siren pools on the wet boulevard, a searchlight helicopter and a roadblock ahead, stars and speedo lit.

name: 3-action.jpg
caption: On foot at Coral Pier: over-the-shoulder SMG firefight with muzzle flash, tracers and hit sparks, the mission objective on the HUD, health and armour, and a police cruiser rolling in.

name: 4-night.jpg
caption: Midnight over Neon Midtown and the Palm Strip: the hero car's lights on the wet boulevard, blazing lit towers and neon hotels, the Ferris wheel turning over the bay, and the city-progress badge.
